assertions.statement: GET / answers JSON with service "receipts", a topicId of the form 0.0.N, and network "local".
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to the server URL. The page body is a JSON object; confirm the three fields and that topicId matches 0.0.<digits>.

assertions.statement: GET /receipts lists at least three receipts read back from the mirror node, oldest first, each a parsed JSON object.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to <server>/receipts. The body is JSON with topicId and a receipts array of at least three objects; the first is the welcome receipt.

assertions.statement: An unknown path answers 404 with JSON {"error": "not found"} and no crash banner.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to <server>/nope. The body is that JSON object; no 'Application error' text anywhere.
